description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - word look: a look-up-a-word-without-your-phone helper for when an unknown English word stops you mid-page - LOOK takes a telephoto photo of the page or sign as a record only (the runtime has no OCR, the photo anchors where you met the word and is never read), SAY hears the word itself in one shot (English recognition first, an honest zh-CN fallback warning, the heard word shown verbatim and never silently corrected - a misheard word earns a wrong definition, so checking it is the product), DEFINE sends the confirmed word as text only to the host LLM for a one-line Chinese meaning, a simple English gloss and one example sentence, falling back to a labelled built-in offline mini-dictionary of 24 common words, SPEAK reads word plus meaning aloud (synthetic TTS speech, not a native recording), and SAVE files the word under a scene (reading / travel / work / daily) into an on-device word book you can browse and review by scene
name: word-look
